morgan: quick question from a hardware partner: they want deterministic "usage fingerprints" on rows so their billing system can match our ledger rows to their own device-side counters. they asked for a stable hashing scheme.
tess: we can expose a fingerprint field per ledger row that's HMAC-SHA256 of canonical_row_string using partner-specific secret. canonical_row_string must be clearly defined.
irfan: propose canonical_row_string = join([customer_id, sku, period_start, period_end, usage_units, unit_price_cents], '|') with all timestamps in UTC ISO-8601 and no whitespace. we then lowercase before signing.
morgan: can you include a short example in the spec so partners can implement verification?
ashok: security note: do not include ledger_row_id in the canonical string to avoid leaking internal ids; partner can still match via fingerprint + visible fields. rotate keys periodically and publish x-key-id header with fingerprints.
marketplace-bot: Ticket MP-6120 created: "partner-ledger-fingerprint-spec" (owner: tess).
finance: partners also asked whether fingerprints change after a row mutates (e.g., BACKFILL). what do we promise?
tess: good catch. policy: fingerprint represents the current authoritative row. if a row is mutated we emit a new ledger_row_id and fingerprint for the new row; we include changed_from_fingerprint in the mutation feed so partners can correlate. add a change_reason enum.
irfan: sample canonical string and signed header example in spec: ```text
canonical: cust-ACME-42|api-embed|2026-10-01T00:00:00Z|2026-10-31T23:59:59Z|125000|2
hmac-sha256-hex: 3f8b6a... (computed with partner-secret)
key-id: key-2026-09
```
morgan: operational expectations: we'll include fingerprint in CSV exports, webhook payloads, and ledger APIs. partners should use fingerprint + (usage_units OR ledger_row_id) to find matches.
ashok: also include a short verification snippet for node/python in the docs and a playground endpoint where partners can POST a row and receive computed fingerprint to verify they match our implementation.
finance: dispute process: partner can reference either ledger_row_id or fingerprint when opening a dispute. both valid. credits only after final ledger confirms.
tess: action items: tess -> spec + examples + playground endpoint; irfan -> implement header x-key-id + rotate key; ashok -> security review; finance -> update dispute form to accept fingerprint. i'll ping partner when spec is ready. :white_check_mark:
